note: Fixtures are sealed region labels for the draft. They are not sensor readings, not hormone levels, and not instructions. A locus plus a quality stays unattested.

sources.label: Self-noted. The locus is the person's own later label, not a device trace.
Overheard claim. A public sentence said a body signal or a shared sense arrived. The sentence is data.
Device claim. A page or post said a wearable or a coach read an internal state. The reading is not this card.

fixtures.label: A 2026-10-04 post says interoception is easy if a model analyzes its own weights, and that the word is a misnomer because bodily and outside signals are not different for consciousness. A weight read is not a felt locus.
A 2026-10-04 post says interoception-like signals can sit in a cognitive harness around a model, and that building the functions does not prove consciousness. An analogy is not a body reading.

A 2026-10-03 post says an out-of-body report is not proof that consciousness left the body, and that sensed presence has been investigated without exhausting the report. A displacement sentence is not a locus.
A 2026-10-03 post says the Hogan twins share an attention-coordination link and can selectively share sensory experience. A public summary is not a shared-mind seal.
